title: CNN Excluded From Air Force One as White House Escalates Media Access Restrictions
detail: CNN was left off the Air Force One press pool for President Trump's upcoming presidential trip, marking an escalation of the White House's media access restrictions. The move signals a broader effort to limit coverage from outlets the administration has publicly branded as adversarial, following the banning of CNN, MSNBC, and Politico reporters from the White House in September 2026.

title: Trump Administration Works to Reshape Electoral Rules Ahead of 2026 Midterms
detail: The Trump administration is pursuing efforts to reshape electoral rules to its advantage ahead of the November 2026 midterm elections, according to a Le Monde analysis. The moves include initiatives on voter registration, election administration, and rules governing federal races that critics say are designed to benefit Republican candidates in the upcoming midterms.
